key_insight: LF-ENN combines neural approximation with structure-preserving enrichment to provide a rigorous locking-free guarantee for nearly incompressible linear elasticity.
engineering_relevance: The method supports accurate displacement prediction as incompressibility increases, without volumetric locking degrading the solution.
method: Enriches a linearized neural trial space to reduce discrete incompressibility constraints to a graph-Laplacian problem.
Constructs divergence-free corrections with error estimates uniform in the Lamé parameter λ.
Uses Nitsche boundary enforcement and tailored stabilization for neural trial spaces.
evidence_signal: In 2D and 3D numerical experiments, LF-ENN demonstrates locking-free behavior; a reported comparison achieves approximately 12× smaller displacement error than a higher-order locking-free enriched Galerkin method with fewer than one-third as many unknowns.
watch_item: The guarantees require suitable approximation and mesh-resolution assumptions; fewer unknowns alone does not establish lower runtime.
paper_title: A locking-free enriched linearized neural network for linear elasticity
